init_c2_xavier_fill: initialize a PyTorch module's weight using Caffe2 XavierFill and set bias to zero
init_c2_msra_fill: initialize a PyTorch module's weight using Caffe2 MSRAFill with Kaiming normal and set bias to zero
review_c2_xavier_fill: review the c2_xavier_fill function that applies Kaiming uniform initialization with a=1 to module weights
review_c2_msra_fill: review the c2_msra_fill function that applies Kaiming normal fan_out initialization to module weights
test_weight_init: test the c2_xavier_fill and c2_msra_fill functions on a PyTorch nn.Linear module
